/whyTourWorks/bestFor/0.source_en: Cruise passengers needing a same-day round-trip from the cruise terminal

/whyTourWorks/bestFor/1.source_en: First-time Jeju visitors who want UNESCO highlights in one day

/whyTourWorks/bestFor/2.source_en: Travelers who want a guided format-appropriate route with smaller group attention

/whyTourWorks/lessIdealFor/0.source_en: Travelers with very low mobility (Seongsan rim and Hallasan 1100 require some walking)

/whyTourWorks/lessIdealFor/2.source_en: Travelers wanting unhurried pacing — cruise schedule is fixed

/whyTourWorks/routeLogicSections/0/items.source_en: Cruise return-time limit is the same; the route adapts to minimize transit waste.

/whyTourWorks/routeLogicSections/1/items.source_en: Smaller group, more guide attention, faster pace through stops.

/routeShapeIntro/subtitle.source_en: Route depends on your cruise port. Jeju Port (north) runs east UNESCO; Gangjeong Port (south) runs Hallasan alpine + Olle Market.

/staticQuestions/0/answer.source_en: Your cruise booking confirmation lists the Jeju port. We confirm the port with you at booking and route the day accordingly. Most major cruise lines call at Jeju Port (north terminal); some Seogwipo-area calls use Gangjeong Port.

/staticQuestions/0/question.source_en: How do I know which port my cruise calls at?

/staticQuestions/1/answer.source_en: Yes. Both route options return to the cruise terminal between 16:30-17:00, with buffer for any traffic delay. We track your sailaway time and adjust pace if conditions change.

/staticQuestions/1/question.source_en: Will I be back to the ship in time?

/staticQuestions/2/answer.source_en: Notify us as soon as you know — we switch the route option to match. Port-routing is the whole reason this tour has two route options instead of one.

/staticQuestions/2/question.source_en: What if my cruise call port changes?

/staticQuestions/3/answer.source_en: Yes — it covers the most distinctive stops in the area in a single balanced day.
/staticQuestions/3/answer.tm: Ja — sie deckt die markantesten Stopps der Region an einem einzigen, ausgewogenen Tag ab.

/staticQuestions/3/question.source_en: Is this a good choice for first-time visitors to Jeju?
/staticQuestions/3/question.tm: Ist das eine gute Wahl für Jeju-Erstbesucher?

/staticQuestions/4/answer.source_en: Moderate walking with some active sections.
/staticQuestions/4/answer.tm: Mäßige Fußwege mit einigen aktiveren Abschnitten.

/staticQuestions/5/answer.tm: Ja — für die meisten Familien angenehm.

/staticQuestions/5/question.source_en: Is this tour suitable for families?
/staticQuestions/5/question.tm: Ist diese Tour für Familien geeignet?

/staticQuestions/6/answer.source_en: Yes for active seniors; less ideal for low-mobility travelers.

/staticQuestions/7/answer.source_en: Best fit is around age 6 and up — children comfortable with a full-day rhythm and the walking notes above.

/staticQuestions/8/answer.source_en: Several stops are exposed; very wet weather may shorten or substitute stops.

/staticQuestions/8/question.source_en: Can the tour run in rainy weather?

/staticQuestions/9/answer.source_en: A lunch break is built into the route. Whether the meal itself is included depends on the booked rate — check the inclusions list.

/staticQuestions/10/answer.source_en: At the cruise terminal arrival hall — Jeju Port (north) or Gangjeong Port (south) depending on where your ship docks. Your guide waits at the gangway-side arrival hall with an AtoC Korea sign and your name. Exact pickup time is confirmed the evening before, based on your ship's posted arrival.

/staticQuestions/10/question.source_en: Where do I get picked up?

/bookingTrustItems/0/body.source_en: Licensed local operator with the same port-based routing as the large-coach version but in a mini-van of max 10 — better for narrow Seongeup village lanes and smaller group dynamics.

/bookingTrustItems/0/description.source_en: Authorized Korean tour operator with full insurance
/bookingTrustItems/0/description.tm: Zugelassener koreanischer Tourveranstalter mit vollem Versicherungsschutz

/bookingTrustItems/1/body.source_en: All admissions to stops on the assigned route are covered in the tour price.

/bookingTrustItems/1/description.source_en: Hand-tuned itinerary, not a generic loop

/bookingTrustItems/2/body.source_en: Ship-return timing: return drop-off to your original terminal 60+ minutes before all-aboard.
